convert_lora_adapter_to_gguf: convert a Hugging Face PEFT LoRA adapter to a GGUF file with specified output format
run_lora_conversion_cli: run the CLI to convert a LoRA adapter from safetensors or bin to GGUF format
build_lora_gguf_with_base_model: build a GGUF LoRA adapter using a local base model directory or Hugging Face model ID
test_lora_conversion_dry_run: test a LoRA to GGUF conversion with dry-run mode to preview without writing files
review_lora_tensor_operations: review the LoraTorchTensor class that wraps LoRA A and B tensors for shape manipulation
